usedFor: Lead form responses from LinkedIn Campaign Manager become records in HubSpot, such as a contact from “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sponsored Lead Form Response” in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It fires on a new response for a chosen ad account and form, and the action creates the HubSpot contact.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so check “New Organic Lead Form Response” carries one from your lead form.
